notes.title: 2022 Update - All I Want For Christmas Is Infinite Lives
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39309977/8d42ab2008f57cd184a05b18171012c44b11661b.png[/img]

[h1]Difficulty Slider[/h1]
Attention, stealthy Santas! Are you tired of starting each level of Ho-Ho-Home Invasion over and over again when you get caught by the training robots? Well, your Christmas wish has been granted - we've added a lives system so you can keep on playing even if you get caught!

Introducing the newest update to Ho-Ho-Home Invasion - "All I Want for Christmas is Infinite Lives".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39309977/08f55213f9ce847fb81dbc00c8be4818fa6f4a7e.gif[/img]

[h2]ALL I WANT FOR CHRISTMAS IS INFINITE LIVES[/h2]With this update, you can choose the number of lives you have per level, allowing you to adjust the difficulty to your liking. And the best part? You can slide the difficulty all the way to Elf mode, which gives you an unlimited number of lives. It's the gift that keeps on giving (literally)!

Watch out for the time penalty though, you'll have 60 seconds added to your total time whenever you get caught. Access this slider for each level from the 'Levels' button on the main menu.

And don't worry, you can still play as [i]sneak-a-claus[/i] intended with the original one chance per level. With seven different house layouts, you'll still need to be a real tinsel toes to avoid the training robots to deliver presents and escape safely.

[h2]LET'S DECK THE LEADERBOARDS![/h2]
And don't forget, we added leaderboards last year so you can compete against other stealthy Santas from around the world. Plus, with support for the latest version of the Tilt Five™ drivers ([url=https://www.tiltfive.com/downloads]1.2.2[/url]), you can enjoy an even more immersive Ho-Ho-Home Invasion experience.

Download the newest update to Ho-Ho-Home Invasion now, and if you're feeling extra generous, you can support the developers with the "pay-what-you-like" model on Steam or by entering a purchase amount on itch.io.

As always, we encourage you to share your clips, streams, and videos with us on Twitter at [url=https://twitter.com/whitepot]@whitepot[/url], or drop in to our community Discord server ([url=https://discord.gg/whitepot]discord.gg/whitepot[/url]) to say hi and share your scores on the leaderboards.

Happy holidays and happy playing!
Whitepot Studios.

P.S. Santa is now quadruple vaxxed

notes.title: Ho-Ho-Home Invasion: REGIFTED 2021 Update
notes.content:
The 2021 update of Whitepot Studios’ free festive stealth game Ho-Ho-Home Invasion, REGIFTED,  is now live. Available to download now on PC through Steam and itch.io.

[previewyoutube=5S4PQo7BjqE;full][/previewyoutube]

If you’ve spent a whole year ho-ho-hoping that this update would finally arrive, then today is your lucky day! Santa has spent the past 12 months working long hours preparing for yet another socially distanced Christmas. He’s boosted, he’s vaxxed, and he’s ready to invade your home.

What’s new? Glad you asked:
[list]
[*] Leaderboards on Steam! Get clocking those times.
[*] Two new lovingly crafted levels - our biggest yet.
[*] A newer, thiccer Santa model
[*] A shiny new robot family - even more aggressively festive. Aggresstive.
[*] A whole host of other improvements and undoubtedly new bugs
[*] … and some very cool compatibility with [url=https://www.tiltfive.com/games/ho-ho-home-invasion]Tilt Five hardware[/url]​!
[/list]

If you’re enjoying Ho-Ho-Home Invasion, do send us your clips, streams, and videos, joining the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S6z1QTNSGbk]likes of Limmy[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kA6t4eJ39-o]GameGrumps [/url] who have already got in on the festive cheer. Reach us on Twitter at @whitepot, or drop in to our community Discord server ([url=https://discord.gg/whitepot]discord.gg/whitepot[/url]) to say hi.

As always, everything in the game is festively free, but you can avail of the pay-what-you-like model by purchasing the ‘support the developer’ content-free DLC on Steam, or entering a purchase amount when downloading the title on itch.io.

Wishing you all a fantastic festive season and safe 2021,
Whitepot Studios ❤

notes.title: That tasty "day one patch" feeling
notes.content:
First thing’s first - thank you SO much to everyone who has played! We are completely blown away by the response - and making it to top of Stealth’s New & Trending 🎉 The best thing you can do to help us out is [b]leave a review[/b] - it really helps boost visibility :D Thanks to everyone who has so far!

[img]https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/T2KqBK0BM9HpQDBY4QQLl_QlCyMTre3cYDDADoDVtK56rh_WZtqSteWKN7FAPJ5C0h14IaKhEFktPSs9oHVaUrUpbHdTTn_4hsU2yOnLSs5QmvEUTW9O7ZbslYDU_i5-dlwGt1kO[/img]

Now, here’s the [u]not-quite-day-one-patch[/u] update I’m sure you’ve all been waiting for.

[list]
[*] [url=#Localization]Localization[/url]
[*] [url=#Watcher]"The Watcher 3"[/url]
[*] [url=#Achievement]"The Master a-Chieve-ment Collection"[/url]
[*] [url=#Rebinding]"The Re-Binding of Isaac"[/url]
[*] [url=#MouseOptions]Mouse Cursor Options[/url]
[*] [url=#Misc]Misc[/url]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2=Localization]Localization[/h2]
We’ve had so many requests for localization on top of this, so we’ve created a crowd-sourced page on Localizor for the community to add their translations. You can check that out here: [url=https://www.localizor.com/ho-ho-home-invasion]https://www.localizor.com/ho-ho-home-invasion[/url] 

Hoping to have the first localizations up over this weekend! We’re over halfway through localizations for the following:
[list][*][b]Portuguese (BR), French, German, Italian.[/b][/*][/list]
And looking for help starting the following languages:
[list][*][b]Russian, Japanese. Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, Dutch, Spanish, and Portuguese (PT).[/b][/*][/list]

[url=https://www.localizor.com/ho-ho-home-invasion][img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/yYDkqIQuAS7iRweu3qWK4RGvbWegdqx4oyDNoRRB1xm5Mt0z9aICkClXN8SThf0rWYgDLv1GTVttlmq5OsxmGV1BGX4mF54kqs9267O5v49_ptDV-_VLyiCJzOsng-0m_gc76d-c[/img][/url]

Thank you so much to the following awesome people who have contributed translations so far:
[list][*]Thitz - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/thitz/]https://steamcommunity.com/id/thitz/[/url] [/*][*]camillesaraiva - [url=https://localizor.com/user/8973]https://localizor.com/user/8973[/url]  [/*][*]AlexisBarroso - [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/alexisbrso/]https://steamcommunity.com/id/alexisbrso/[/url] [/*][*]LisaBellu - [url=https://www.localizor.com/user/8977/]https://www.localizor.com/user/8977/[/url] [/*][/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h2="Watcher"]"The Watcher 3"[/h2]
We moved the Watcher on Level 3 to make him react better to being lured out by whistling. If you’d like to see what happened instead, prior to this update, you can watch [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jtc-Mcy7sRo]Droogie4Ever descending into misery[/url].

[img]https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/sljlGSKoJU-A3SveCJKSbQUlQCAcGZRViPBYUX4kaTNEQevVZgChCTzbxBsPgYM9Y9gA1Ao3Bip1I8eJpMovdEWX5oR2wF2DCmHJTSYhlM5sb2T_oVeJRuzowMxsWR6F5U6ZfVjQ[/img]

[hr][/hr]

[h2="Achievement"]"The Master a-Chieve-ment Collection"[/h2]
There were some hiccups with the ‘Present Collection’ achievement unlocking, which have now been fixed. If you’ve met the requirements, these achievements should unlock upon opening the game if you haven’t played since this update. 

[img]https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/DS5qlez12JxBhEB2nqBQniKAWeH6rL5_h2UfA1j7W6uXhCe5jGCTUAUHs3gS4m6OWvsh5bpBPb1FVzikTzfaozPK-7tNd6y8haoB4Nh3wzvEYYlU0PzfYmJKNq4AgrfJj5LBzs73[/img]

Congrats to Fellyjish for being the first to 100% Ho-Ho-Home Invasion! Truly, you are the ‘Master Achievement’.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Accessibility[/h2]
[h3="Rebinding"]"The Re-Binding of Isaac"[/h3]

[img]https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/lE0-BKKVZgL1F7r1Cvn5Jlu4cUXj4mgMDQWcszGQL2mhxXisLRQBfFKXV84Zx5fdXdFZels2t6I6b0vQoDGHkI8JXt0Vq9IvbeIY_6K5epMaXqOwkvh7DL0Lxk4fnmcSJyytFt5d[/img]

To my dear AZERTY keyboard layout friends - we have now added a keyboard binding screen so you can rebind from WASD to QSZD, and never [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/CSPasta/comments/52ji5i/why_does_scream_use_qszd_movement/]feel like this[/url] ever again. You can access this from the ‘Controls’ menu by selecting ‘Rebind’ at the bottom right.

[img]https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/OlicpKNzE6hRnm2SXXtbQFWcDXw4MDWuhCUV56fWdxIAN83SNj409fnPus0HkmJjwqcsYXNfY1rxodJaCbDgoeM_r_TWN-1PIQJQl1T9LsvN2fIU2zmoo8Mdf20Qxj_CWr85CjTn[/img]

[img]https://lh5.googleusercontent.com/ShRm8qXUmgIjbMyfmroZfLRwu9kw5qwR96KnkVIceKI4g2qsmRHX-_DYEZqzHtUeEpyuEIqqcjJ6nwSlii5zop7D0x832pY5oTsKUIIU8fQNMZJ_RQeqWAHvCuFGEu1Wn3BTvNN7[/img]

[h3="MouseOptions"]Mouse Cursor Options[/h3]
The options menu now ~scrolls~ so we could fit more in there. You can scroll to the bottom of the options menu to change the following accessibility options.

[list]
[*][b]Don’t Lock Mouse Cursor [/b]- allows it to move from the centre of the screen when playing[/*]
[*][b]Don’t Constrain Mouse Cursor to Game Window[/b] - allows the mouse cursor to leave the game window when your mouse reaches the edges of it[/*]
[*][b]Don’t Hide the Mouse Cursor[/b] - allows the mouse cursor to be shown at all times.[/*][/list]

[img]https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/TXviiSPQREvL-BYrHkUZcMpZHS3u2A5hHvJZVJ_wjLzWsDx6fgxTIgSAs6z42ksHVAulGUQzHfdC7_m3Pgd98_68E10YjFYkTmamYqfM0TBQPsZm5qJFk2aNkdxSLTuZaAl5qz2Y[/img]

Please let us know what further accessibility adjustments would be useful and we’ll try our best to make them. You can post in the Discussions forum or e-mail [url=mailto:hello@whitepotstudios.com]hello@whitepotstudios.com[/url].
[hr][/hr]
[h2="Misc"]Misc.[/h2]
[list]
[*]Anti-aliasing has been fixed!
[*]‘Thier’ changed to ‘Their’ in the tutorial 😳
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

Stay sneaky, Santas!
[list][*]Vicky[/*][/list]
